text:
สวัสดี! Sawasdee! 👋🐘

Meet Nong Chang, a baby elephant who helps families learn languages together.

I'm a dad in the UK and built this so families can learn side by side: short 5-minute lessons with real native voices, picture cards and games for the kids. Learn Thai, French or Spanish, free and with no ads 👉 nongchang.co.uk

Elephants never forget. Neither will you! 🐘

What does "Nong Chang" mean? 🤔

🐘 ช้าง (cháang) = elephant
👧 น้อง (nóng) = little one, or younger brother or sister

So น้องช้าง (Nong Chang) means "little elephant"! Thai people often call someone younger "nóng" in a warm, friendly way.

Learn more words like this 👉 nongchang.co.uk

spec.title: Thai word of the week
lines: สวัสดีครับ

text:
🇹🇭 Thai word of the week

สวัสดี (sà-wàt-dii) = hello, and goodbye too!

To sound polite, add:
👨 ครับ (khráp) if you're male: สวัสดีครับ
👩 ค่ะ (khâ) if you're female: สวัสดีค่ะ

Put your hands together in a small bow (a "wai") as you say it 🙏

nongchang.co.uk

🇫🇷 French word of the week

Bonjour (bon-ZHOOR) = hello / good morning
Bonsoir (bon-SWAHR) = good evening
Au revoir (oh ruh-VWAHR) = goodbye

In France it's polite to say "Bonjour" when you walk into a shop or café 😊

Free French lessons for the whole family 👉 nongchang.co.uk

Did you know Thai has 44 consonants? 😮 Don't worry, each one comes with a picture word to help you remember it.

ก = a "g" sound. Its name is ก ไก่ (gaw gài), "g for chicken" 🐔
ข = a "kh" sound. Its name is ข ไข่ (khǎw khài), "kh for egg" 🥚

Our free "Read Thai" lessons teach the alphabet and vowels step by step, for kids and grown-ups 👉 nongchang.co.uk

spec.title: Fun fact: Thai has 5 tones
spec.big: มา  ม้า  หมา

text:
🎵 Fun fact: Thai has 5 tones!

The same sound can mean different things depending on your tone of voice:

มา (maa) = come
ม้า (máa) = horse 🐴
หมา (mǎa) = dog 🐶

So be careful you don't call the horse a dog! 😄 Nong Chang plays every word with real native audio so you can hear the difference.

👉 nongchang.co.uk

🔤 Read Thai: two more letters!

ค = a "kh" sound. Its name is ค ควาย (khaw khwaai), "kh for buffalo" 🐃
ง = an "ng" sound. Its name is ง งู (ngaw nguu), "ng for snake" 🐍

The "ng" sound is like the end of "sing", but Thai puts it at the start of words too. Try it: ngaw! 😄

How do you say thank you? 🙏

🇫🇷 Merci (mair-SEE)
🇪🇸 Gracias (GRAH-see-as)

🔢 Count to 3 in Thai!

หนึ่ง (nùeng) = 1
สอง (sǎawng) = 2
สาม (sǎam) = 3

Try counting the stairs at home in Thai with your kids 😄

nongchang.co.uk

🔢 Count to 3 in French!

un (uhn) = 1
deux (duh) = 2
trois (trwah) = 3

Un, deux, trois... allez! 🇫🇷 Free French lessons 👉 nongchang.co.uk

🔤 Read Thai: your first vowel!

า = a long "aa" sound, like in "father"

It sits after the consonant:
ม + า = มา (maa) = come
ต + า = ตา (taa) = eye 👁️

Nong Chang's Read Thai track has 7 vowel lessons to get you reading 👉 nongchang.co.uk

spec.title: Useful phrase
spec.big: ขอน้ำหน่อย

text:
🍽️ Useful phrase for the Thai restaurant

ขอน้ำหน่อย (khǎw náam nòi) = some water, please

ขอ (khǎw) = may I have
น้ำ (náam) = water 💧
หน่อย (nòi) = a little (makes it softer and friendlier)

Add ครับ (khráp) or ค่ะ (khâ) at the end to be extra polite 😊
